ELECTION OF MEMBERS OF SENATE FROM THE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL

ELECTION OF

2002.
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 39 OF 2002
An Order to repeal the Election of Members of Senate from
the Federally Administered tribal Areas Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
20-11-2002 ---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Election of Members of
Senate from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Repeal) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into-force at
once.
